## Definition of done

- [ ] Tests written first and passing (`pnpm check`)
- [ ] No contract change, or an ADR is included
- [ ] No client or employer names, code or data (deny-list passes)
- [ ] Docs and changelog updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Screens: empty, loading and error states; accessibility checked

## Review

- [ ] Reviewed by a separate reviewer session against the spec and contracts
- [ ] Approved by a human maintainer
